skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Alighting
skins.content: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/Alighting. Magnum opus of a Yumen craftsman, given to a traveler heading on a long journey. In the hope that men and might need no longer be a burden, that he can wander for myriad li with ease.
skins.quote: O lush wood, how long have you stood? O fluttering pale plumes, how far have you wandered? The seasons turn, and the white feathers return not. O barren tree, where could they perch?

skins.name: All-Round Actor
skins.content: Collaborative Series/All-Round Actor. Clothes Chongyue wears when studying past roles. The characters are so different, so how should one breathe life into them? He browses both scripts and tapes, experiencing life after life after life.
skins.quote: Having suddenly gone from stunt coordinator to leading man, Chongyue admits he's not too sure what to do right now, especially after seeing one younger sister sitting in the director's chair, and another on the set drinking from her flask.
